related.title: PostgreSQL：hash join 的記憶體與 spill
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用每區塊 min/max 模型判斷時間條件可跳過多少區塊。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use block min/max summaries to identify blocks skippable by a time predicate. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 用小表建 hash 與大表 probe，分析容量不足時為何需要分割。
related.differenceEn: Build a hash table on the small relation and probe with the large one,then analyze capacity-driven partitioning.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: BRIN 摘要是有損候選篩選，需回表 recheck；資料與物理位置的相關性影響效益。 教學基準：10-1 = 9 skippable blocks；第二檢核：449-420+1 = 30 matching rows。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Hash join 依 join key 配對；重複鍵保留所有匹配，記憶體成本取決於 build 端及 overhead。 教學基準：50000*(32+24) = 2800000 modeled hash bytes；第二檢核：ceil(2800000/(2*1024*1024)) = 2 ideal capacity partitions。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: BRIN summaries provide lossy candidate filtering requiring rechecks; physical correlation affects benefit. Teaching baseline: 10-1 = 9 skippable blocks; second check: 449-420+1 = 30 matching rows. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Hash joins match join keys and preserve duplicates; memory depends on the build side and overhead. Teaching baseline: 50000*(32+24) = 2800000 modeled hash bytes; second check: ceil(2800000/(2*1024*1024)) = 2 ideal capacity partitions. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Paxos：promise、accepted 與提案值繼承
related.titleEn: Paxos: promises,accepted values and value inheritance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用每區塊 min/max 模型判斷時間條件可跳過多少區塊。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use block min/max summaries to identify blocks skippable by a time predicate. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 在三個 acceptor 的 Phase 1 回覆中選擇必須繼承的值。
related.differenceEn: Choose the value a proposer must inherit from Phase 1 responses of three acceptors.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

若 prepare quorum 包含已接受提案，選最高 accepted ballot 的值；promise 與 accepted 記錄不同。 教學基準：max(4,7) = 7 highest accepted ballot；第二檢核：floor(3/2)+1 = 2 quorum size。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Teaching baseline: 10-1 = 9 skippable blocks; second check: 449-420+1 = 30 matching rows. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

When a prepare quorum reports accepted proposals,choose the value with the highest accepted ballot; promised and accepted records differ. Teaching baseline: max(4,7) = 7 highest accepted ballot; second check: floor(3/2)+1 = 2 quorum size. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries.
